release_notes:
fix: return clean 404 for missing .php instead of mod_php error

Requests for non-existent .php files (bot scans for /aaa.php, /wp-xx.php,
etc.) made mod_php stat a missing script and log '[php:error] script not
found or unable to stat' before ErrorDocument ran. Rewrite missing .php
requests to /404.php so the PHP handler never runs on a missing file, and
have 404.php send a real 404 status.

(cherry picked from commit 3873f1f15b2e8a5e89c54be3361e0fa264eea16e)
